scripts.purpose: Creates a gzip-compressed tar archive of BACKUP_SOURCES with EXCLUDES and verifies it, optionally sending a desktop notification. --dry-run validates the setup without creating an archive.

arguments.name: -h|--help
arguments.description: Print usage and the option list, then exit 0.

arguments.name: -c|--config-file FILE
arguments.description: Load settings from FILE; takes precedence over USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG and installed/legacy/repository lookup. A missing value exits 2.

arguments.name: --config-file=FILE
arguments.description: Equivalent to -c FILE; an empty value exits 2.

arguments.name: --dry-run
arguments.description: Skip archive creation and verification; report the archive path that would be produced.

arguments.name: --wait-for-notification-daemon
arguments.description: Wait in 60-second intervals until dunst, mako, xfce4-notifyd, or notification-daemon is running.

arguments.name: --notify-send
arguments.description: Send a desktop notification after completion; exits 1 when no notification daemon is running.

environment.name: USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG
environment.description: Config file path used when no config-file option is given.

environment.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
environment.description: Base directory for the installed config lookup.

environment.name: BACKUP_DIR
environment.description: Destination directory for the archive; created when missing.

exit_codes.meaning: Help printed, dry-run completed, or archive created and verified; a notification is sent when requested.
Config file unreadable, a BACKUP_SOURCES directory missing, archive creation or verification failed, no notification daemon running with --notify-send, or an unknown option supplied.
A config-file option was supplied without a non-empty value.
